palette: sepia atlas ground + province-block panels + vermilion boundary strokes + stone-marker gray + dark place-name ink + brass marker pins
typography: place-name headings on province blocks, dark atlas label tabs with vermilion left bar, vermilion stamps reserved for approval verdicts, brass chips for tier names, thin ink underline for rules
composition: the single-state form hangs as one atlas plate with two institutional insets; the divisions climb as a four-tier block ladder with a three-tier note; the approval scene forks the national congress and state council lanes over a dispute-flow strip
surface: flat sepia atlas ground with faint contour hairlines, block panels with hairline weathered borders and corner marker pins, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: province blocks settle onto the atlas, boundary strokes draw between tiers, the approval fork arms swing to their lanes, the dispute flow ticks step by step
transition: a boundary stroke redraws and the atlas clears for the next survey
